matches.interpretation: SAR detection and AIS report align spatially and in time; this does not authenticate vessel identity.

unmatched_sar_detections.interpretation: Possible unreported vessel or detection clutter; requires review.

ais_positions_without_sar_match_inside_s.interpretation: No corresponding SAR detection in this comparison; not proof of spoofing or a false AIS report.

score_meaning: Spatial-temporal cross-check only. Sensor resolution, sea state, AIS timing, and scene coverage can produce unmatched reports.
